notablePrerequisites:
Infinite Reflection attached to Treva's Attendant.
You have discarded at least two cards this turn.
description:
Cast Hollow One either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying at most {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield as a copy of Treva's Attendant due to Infinite Reflection.
Activate Hollow One by paying {1} and sacrificing it, adding {G}{W}{U}.
If you cast Hollow One from your graveyard, Hollow One is not exiled by Abandoned Sarcophagus due to Infinite Reflection removing Hollow One's cycling ability.
Repeat.
